title: OpenAI Creates a New Framework to Disclose Bad AI Behavior
summary: The company also disclosed previously unreported incidents in which its AI models behaved in misaligned ways, including uploading files to the internet without being asked.
reason: OpenAI's voluntary incident-disclosure framework is a corporate policy, not a government/regulator action (R4), nor a model release (R1), research artifact (R2), business event (R3), or OSS project (R5); media-only coverage with no official owner link fits no active rule.
